body:
## Pull request overview

Integrates the existing `AppCreationWizard` from `@object-ui/plugin-designer` into the Console app by adding routes/pages, UI entry points, i18n keys, docs, roadmap updates, and an integration test suite.

**Changes:**
- Added Console routes + pages for creating/editing apps (`CreateAppPage`, `EditAppPage`) and allowed create-app access even with no active app.
- Added entry points in AppSidebar and CommandPalette, plus empty-state CTAs when no apps are configured.
- Added `createApp` i18n key across 10 locales, updated docs/roadmap, and added console integration tests.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 19 out of 19 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Adds lazy-loaded create/edit routes and empty-state CTA; bypasses active-app guard for create-app. |
| apps/console/src/pages/CreateAppPage.tsx | New wizard page for app creation with localStorage draft handling and completion callback. |
| apps/console/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx | New wizard page for editing an existing app via `initialDraft`. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds App Switcher dropdown entry points for Add/Edit App. |
| apps/console/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx | Adds “Create New App” command item in Actions group. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/app-creation-integration.test.tsx | Adds integration tests for routing and wizard callback wiring (with mocks). |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,zh,es,fr,de,ar,ru,pt,ja,ko}.ts | Adds `console.commandPalette.createApp` translation key. |
| content/docs/guide/console.md | Documents wizard feature and new pages folder structure. |
| content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md | Documents new routes and “App Creation & Editing” architecture section. |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds Console Integration checklist items related to wizard integration. |
</details>

`onSaveDraft` writes an edit draft to localStorage, but this page never reads it back (so a reload can’t restore the saved draft). Either load and merge the saved draft into `initialDraft` on mount, or remove/disable draft saving for edit mode to avoid giving users a false sense of persistence.

`isCreateAppRoute` uses `location.pathname.endsWith('/create-app')`, which will fail for valid URLs with a trailing slash (e.g. `/apps/x/create-app/`) and incorrectly fall back to the "No Apps Configured" empty state. Use a route match (`matchPath`) or a more robust check like `/\/create-app\/?$/` so the bypass guard works reliably.
```suggestion
  const isCreateAppRoute = /\/create-app\/?$/.test(location.pathname);
```

New behavior introduced here (empty-state "Create Your First App" CTA + create-app route bypass when there’s no active app) isn’t covered by the added integration tests. Add a test case with `apps: []` that asserts: (1) the empty state renders the CTA, (2) clicking it navigates to `/apps/_new/create-app`, and (3) the wizard renders in the minimal layout path.

These tests are named as if they verify navigation/cancel behavior, but they don’t assert any outcome after the click. Add concrete assertions (e.g., assert the expected empty state / route content renders, or observe the router location) so the tests will fail if navigation wiring regresses.

The file header claims coverage for the empty state "Create Your First App" CTA and AppSidebar entry points, but there are no corresponding assertions/tests in this file. Either add the missing test cases or update the header comment to reflect what’s actually covered to avoid misleading future maintainers.
```suggestion
 * - CommandPalette "Create New App" command
```

These checklist items describe routes as `/create-app` and `/edit-app/:appName`, but the actual console routes are nested under `/apps/:appName/…` (e.g. `/apps/:appName/create-app`, `/apps/:appName/edit-app/:editAppName`). Update the roadmap entries to match the real paths so future readers don’t follow incorrect routes.
```suggestion
- [x] AppSidebar "Add App" button → navigates to `/apps/:appName/create-app`
- [x] AppSidebar "Edit App" button → navigates to `/apps/:appName/edit-app/:editAppName`
- [x] CommandPalette "Create New App" command (⌘+K → Actions group) → navigates to `/apps/:appName/create-app`
```

`handleComplete` converts the draft to an app schema but never persists it (no API call / metadata write). As a result, the "created" app won’t exist after refresh and `refresh()` cannot make it appear. Persist the result of `wizardDraftToAppSchema(draft)` via the metadata/DefineApp API (or the console adapter’s client), and only toast+navigate after the create succeeds.

Same as create: `handleComplete` computes `_appSchema` but doesn’t actually update the existing app anywhere. This makes the "updated successfully" toast misleading and means edits are lost on refresh. Use the adapter/client to persist the updated schema (update/define) and only call `refresh()`+navigate after the update succeeds.
